newsitem.title: USA: Zions Bancorp, Aspen Bancshares to merge.
newsitem.headline: Zions Bancorp, Aspen Bancshares to merge.

text.p: Zions Bancorp said it had signed a definitive agreement with Aspen Bancshares Inc in which Aspen will merge with Zions in exchange for shares in Zions.
Zions said the $75 million transaction was expected to close late in the first quarter or early in the second quarter of 1997.
It said the merger was structured as a tax-free exchange of shares and to be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.
Each Aspen share will be converted into Zions' shares at a ratio based upon Zions' average share price prior to closing, it added.
With assets of about $450 million, Aspen Bancshares is the largest banking company headquartered in western Colorado.

With assets of $6.8 billion, Zions Bancorp operates banking offices throughout Utah, Arizona, and Nevada through its Zions First National Bank, National Bank of Arizona, and Nevada State Bank subsidiaries.
